ranking: Existing chat-rrf-v1: equal-weight RRF60, 20+20 pools, eight evidence candidates. No tuning or cosine cutoff.
baseline: Cosine-only top-five, same pinned encoder/catalog and hard recommendation prefilters. No title routing, lexical query or fusion; shared interpretation/memory/evidence/generator/validation. Fact queries use the current message and neutral lookup filters; recommendation queries use interpreted relevant intent. Exclusion identity resolution remains shared memory infrastructure.
offline: Oracle TurnPlans annotated from frozen expected intent/criteria and extracted title strings; scripted first-four selection. Measures retrieval/state integration conditional on correct interpretation, not natural-language interpretation or generation quality. Expected/anchor IDs never enter semantic queries. Canonical titles for already annotated named references/exclusions are explicit oracle information.
quality: Only real-catalog cases can contribute real-generation scores. Anchors are nonexhaustive curation seeds, not Recall@8 labels. Human relevance/unsupported-prose quality gates remain pending until human judgments and full held-out output exist.

live_pilot.resume: Never replay started/failed turns or provider attempts. Checkpoint before reservations; interrupted work is indeterminate, not free to retry. Honor at least 30.1 seconds between turns, including across restarts.
